## Referenced footnotes

The examples of the [footnotes module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/footnotes.md)
whose behavior `M4` landed: the citation model over the inherited referenced
form. They are the module's examples in the module's order; the inline-form
examples arrive with `O4`. The expected dumps are the module's expected dumps in
the dump grammar of today, which does not yet print the universal `anchor` and
`attributes` fields that `M7` lands, so every `Markup` line differs from the
module's by exactly ` anchor=null attributes={}` and by nothing else, and every
`Citation`, `Footnote`, and group line is identical.

A defined call is a one-item `Cite` whose `Citation` names the footnote by its normalized id with empty affixes, and every winning definition is a `Footnote` under `Document` after the content:

```````````````````````````````` example
Text[^1] and more[^note].

[^1]: The first note.
[^note]: The second note.
.
Document scope=1:1..4:25 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:25 children=5
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 literal="Text" children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:5..1:8 children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:6..1:7 referent=footnote(id="1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:9..1:17 literal=" and more" children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:18..1:24 children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:19..1:23 referent=footnote(id="note") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 literal="." children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..3:21 id="1" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:21 children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:7..3:21 literal="The first note." children=0
└── Footnote scope=4:1..4:25 id="note" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=4:10..4:25 children=1
        └── Text scope=4:10..4:25 literal="The second note." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Repeated calls share one `Footnote`; the body is never duplicated:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a] [^a]

[^a]: once
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:5 literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:6..1:9 children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:7..1:8 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 literal="once" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Continuation lines are indented at least four columns, and the content is block content parsed by the ordinary block parser:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: first paragraph
    continued

    second paragraph
.
Document scope=1:1..6:20 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..6:20 id="a" children=2
    ├── Paragraph scope=3:7..4:13 children=3
    │   ├── Text scope=3:7..3:21 literal="first paragraph" children=0
    │   ├── SoftBreak scope=3:22..3:22 children=0
    │   └── Text scope=4:5..4:13 literal="continued" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=6:5..6:20 children=1
        └── Text scope=6:5..6:20 literal="second paragraph" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A valid definition that no call references is still a `Footnote`:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]: kept

text
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:4 children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 literal="text" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:1..2:0 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:10 children=1
        └── Text scope=1:7..1:10 literal="kept" children=0
````````````````````````````````

When two definitions share a key the first in source order wins; a later one is ordinary content whose leading `[^label]` is itself a call to the winner:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: first

[^a]: second
.
Document scope=1:1..5:12 children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:12 children=2
│   ├── Cite scope=5:1..5:4 children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=5:2..5:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:5..5:12 literal=": second" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..4:0 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:11 children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:11 literal="first" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A call whose label no definition defines is not a call, and only a literal source caret opens a call:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^x] and [\^a] and [&#94;a]

[^a]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:27 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:27 literal="[^x] and [^a] and [^a]" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The key is case-folded, so a call and a definition that differ in case share one footnote, whose id is the normalized form:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^Note]

[^note]: x
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:7 children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:7 children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:6 referent=footnote(id="note") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="note" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:10..3:10 children=1
        └── Text scope=3:10..3:10 literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A valid direct tail `(...)` is tested before the call; every other tail and every container after a defined call is text:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a](u) [^a]{.x}

[^a]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:16 children=4
│   ├── Link scope=1:1..1:7 dest=url("u") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:3 literal="^a" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:9..1:12 children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:10..1:11 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:13..1:16 literal="{.x}" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A call inside a footnote's own content is an id edge, and a `[^label]:` line is never a link reference definition:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: see [^b]
[^b]: end
.
Document scope=1:1..4:9 children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..3:14 id="a" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:14 children=2
│       ├── Text scope=3:7..3:10 literal="see " children=0
│       └── Cite scope=3:11..3:14 children=1
│           └── Citation scope=3:12..3:13 referent=footnote(id="b") children=0
│               ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│               └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=4:1..4:9 id="b" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=4:7..4:9 children=1
        └── Text scope=4:7..4:9 literal="end" children=0
````````````````````````````````
